about_the_game:
Alone on the Lost Isle
The island is silent. But it has secrets.

A shipwreck takes everything away except you... and your faithful dog.
You wake up on a huge, mysterious island full of ruins, traces of a vanished civilization, and strange scientific objects. There is no map, no help. Just you, nature, and the hidden mechanisms of the past.

Survival without instructions:
Collect resources, build a shelter, hunt, purify water, and explore every corner of the island. There are no markers here, but there are clues in the surrounding world.

The dog is more than just a companion:
He senses a threat before you do, finds resources, helps you hunt... and stays close when it gets scary.

An open world, but with a secret:
The island lives its own life - with weather, day and night, sounds of nature, and unexpected finds.
You are free to go wherever you want, but every road can lead to a solution or death.
What happened here? Who left the ruins, bunkers and strange signals?

No mercy:
Wild animals, survivors with unclear intentions and the island itself will test your readiness to survive.
Mistakes are not forgiven. Supplies are running low.
You are alone here - but not quite.

Alone on the Lost Isle is an atmospheric survival sandbox in the spirit of The Forest and the LOST series, where decisions, observation and a sense of loneliness are important.
Can you survive... and get out?
